response.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(1.0 * derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_item_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count FROM per_item

assumptions.assumption: A zero derived_total_cost makes the ratio undefined, so that ratio is skipped.
